Q3 2026 results reported after close: revenue $1,306M (Semiconductor Test $1,072M, Product Test $138M, Robotics $96M — Robotics' highest-ever Q3 revenue and reported profitable), non-GAAP EPS $2.29 (GAAP EPS $2.17, GAAP net income $342.4M, non-GAAP net income $359.9M); both revenue and EPS beat consensus (~$1.26-1.27B / ~$2.08) and came in above the company's own July guidance ($1.2-1.3B revenue / $1.79-$2.09 GAAP EPS). Company guided Q4 2026 to $1.25B-$1.35B revenue and $1.95-$2.25 non-GAAP EPS.
catalysts.impact: Despite the beat-and-raise, shares were reported down approximately 6.7% following the release
